# Lattice

> Free board for blockchain, crypto, and Web3 jobs — live roles from public employer ATS boards. Not a marketplace and not an employer.

Lattice lists still-open Web3 / crypto / blockchain roles pulled from Greenhouse, Ashby, and Lever JSON. Apply on the employer site. Pay is only shown when the board publishes it.

## Site

- Home: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/
- Roles (Web3 & crypto jobs): https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/roles
- Job hubs (Solidity, DeFi, Ethereum, Remote): https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/jobs
- Solidity jobs: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/jobs/solidity
- DeFi jobs: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/jobs/defi
- Ethereum jobs: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/jobs/ethereum
- Remote Web3 jobs: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/jobs/remote-web3
- Companies: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/companies
- Gigs: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/gigs
- Talent: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/talent
- Salaries: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/salaries
- Learn: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/learn
- About: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/about
